title: Censor Bleep
blurb: The 1000 Hz censor bleep — television's universal way of saying you know exactly what word that was. This is the clean, full-length one-second version, perfect for bleeping out names, brands, or your friend's terrible opinions in edits and streams. It's the sound Bleepboard is named after: press it over anything and the moment instantly becomes funnier than the uncensored version ever was.
origin: Broadcast TV censorship tone, standardized around a 1 kHz sine wave.
